_about: The first draft's CI job. It evaluates the full-precision model, quantizes, signs everything and ships.
_evaluate_shipped: false = only the fp32 model is evaluated. The quantized file that actually ships is never run.
_rich_bom: false = the ML-BOM names the model and its hash, nothing else: no base model (pedigree), no eval numbers.
_ship_public_key: true = keys/ci.pub is copied next to the model 'so the deploy step can find it'.
